decisions.reason: Changing the MeetAlfred subscription to Pro does not change the separate requirement to create and configure the Zapier account.
The MeetAlfred plan upgrade does not alter the deferred synchronization requirement or its established Zapier integration method.
The subscription upgrade does not change the required silent-lead recirculation, MeetAlfred export, or no-manual-cleanup behavior.
Upgrading the MeetAlfred plan does not modify the requirement that the existing integration remain connected during the ongoing campaign.
The source changes the MeetAlfred subscription, whereas this requirement uses the Sales Navigator-to-Apollo-to-HubSpot path and remains unchanged.
The MeetAlfred plan selection does not resolve or change how existing CRM records should be shown to users.
The subscription upgrade does not change which communication channels must be visible in HubSpot lead records.
The MeetAlfred plan upgrade does not resolve or change the CRM handling of LinkedIn and Sales Navigator profile URLs.
